course_name_original: Termodinámica técnica y fundamentos de transmisión de calor
course_name_en: Technical Thermodynamics and Fundamentals of Heat Transfer

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge of applied thermodynamics and heat transfer. Basic principles and their application to solving engineering problems.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning, and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and abilities in the field of Industrial Engineering.

Permanent self-learning. To use learning continuously and develop autonomous and flexible learning strategies throughout life to be part of an active, motivated and integrated citizenry, promoting job improvement or personal development.
Know the thermophysical properties of industrial interest and be able to use and select appropriate procedures and tools for their calculation.
Know and apply the laws of thermodynamics to the energetic analysis of basic equipment and processes in engineering.
Acquire the basic criteria for the analysis of thermodynamic cycles.
Know the basic mechanisms of heat transfer for the analysis of thermal equipment.
Solve basic technical thermodynamics problems applied to engineering in a reasoned manner.

syllabus_topics: Basic concepts: thermodynamic system, properties and state of a substance, state principle, equilibrium, thermodynamic processes, energy transfers (heat and work).
Behavior of pure substances: Heterogeneous systems, PvT surface, thermodynamic diagrams, tables of thermodynamic properties.
Treatment of pure substances: equations of state, ideal and real gas model, incompressible substance model.
First law of thermodynamics: energy balance in closed systems.
First law of thermodynamics: energy balance in open systems.
Power cycles in steam turbines: Rankine power cycle.

assessment_methods.method: Moodle questionnaire for transversal competence UZ5

assessment_rules: In the ordinary call, continuous evaluation yields a final grade of 20% practical sessions and 80% final exam, requiring minimum scores of 5/10 for practices and 4.5/10 for the final exam, and a weighted total of 5/10. Failure to meet these conditions results in non-continuous evaluation, where the final exam accounts for 100% of the grade, requiring a minimum of 5/10. The extraordinary call applies the same procedures. The UZ5 transversal competence is assessed via a specific Moodle questionnaire.
